hypothesis: The exact v51 SP500/SPCX live-v3 route may retain an attributable after-cost edge when its backend and source-native observer decisions remain identical and complete lifecycles occur on both configured sides.
decision: Continue exact live collection without changing the route. The expanded current-run window proves backend-observer decision parity for 17 completed boundaries per symbol, including the 11:15 UTC boundary, but contains no eligible onset or lifecycle and therefore does not update economic-edge confidence.
falsifier: Reject the live-translation hypothesis if backend-observer decisions diverge, source coverage becomes incomplete, or a predeclared set of resolved long and short lifecycles is non-positive after exact fees, funding, slippage, latency, stop behavior, and largest-winner removal.
limitations: Thirty-four matching decisions validate current-run attribution only; they do not establish fills or profitability.
The expanded window contains no eligible onset and no long or short lifecycle.
Backend and observer processes may still share an upstream public-data defect.
Archive and live-v3 source identities remain non-interchangeable.
No live strategy, route, parameter, sizing, leverage, stop, target, exit, or execution behavior changed.
